source.title: Reconstructability analysis: Aims, results, open problems

needs_review.question_text_raw: Crossref metadata and the zbMATH review indicate that the paper outlines important issues requiring further research, but no readable exact-work full-text copy was recoverable from the DOI landing page, Crossref/OpenAlex links, or exact-title web search results.

evidence.quote: It contains a description of problems that are studied under RA, a summary of main results obtained within RA, an outline of some important issues associated with RA that require further research

trace.notes: Resolved the zbMATH record to the exact work title and DOI, then checked DOI/Crossref/OpenAlex and exact-title search results for a readable exact-work source. No readable PDF or HTML full text for the same work was recoverable.
No candidate questions were extracted because the accessible materials were bibliographic metadata, review text, and abstract-level summaries rather than the article's full technical text.
Failed source adequacy gate: the exact work could be identified, but the accessible sources did not expose the full problem statements from the paper itself.
